title: The 3 Best Baby Monitors for Toddlers
h1: The 3 Best Baby Monitors for Toddlers
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for baby monitors for toddlers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at baby monitors for toddlers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Nanit Pro Smart Baby Monitor & Flex Stand
products.blurb: Key specs: 1080p Wi-Fi video with wide room coverage, Sleep tracking continues to log naps and bedtime through toddlerhood, Two-way audio for talking a toddler back to sleep.
strengths: Sleep data carries over from crib to floor bed, useful for spotting regressions
Wide-angle overhead view keeps a whole toddler room in frame after a bed transition
Two-way audio lets a parent verbally resettle a toddler without entering the room
limitations: No manual pan or tilt, so a toddler who moves to a room edge can leave the frame
Ongoing sleep insights depend on the paid subscription after year one
Higher price than either non-Wi-Fi option in this list
features: 1080p Wi-Fi video with wide room coverage
Sleep tracking continues to log naps and bedtime through toddlerhood
Two-way audio for talking a toddler back to sleep
Flex stand can be repositioned as a room layout changes
Motion and sound alerts adjust as a toddler becomes more active

products.name: Infant Optics DXR-8 Video Baby Monitor
products.blurb: Key specs: Manual pan, tilt and zoom from the parent unit, Interchangeable lens system, 3.5-inch screen with LED sound bar.
strengths: Manual pan and tilt lets a parent actively follow a toddler moving around the room
Zoom lens can be swapped to a wider-angle option for a full toddler bedroom
No subscription needed as sleep-tracking features become less central
limitations: No sleep-pattern logging or history the way Wi-Fi monitors provide
3.5-inch screen makes fine detail harder to see across a larger room
No remote check-in if you're away from the house
features: Manual pan, tilt and zoom from the parent unit
Two-way talk and automatic night vision

products.name: Owlet Cam 2 Smart Baby Monitor
products.blurb: Key specs: 130-degree wide-angle lens, 1080p HD video with 4x zoom, Night vision and encrypted streaming.
strengths: 130-degree wide-angle lens covers more of a toddler room than a standard-angle camera
4x zoom compensates somewhat for the fixed wide-angle mount
Encrypted Wi-Fi streaming and app access work the same as during infancy
limitations: No physical pan or tilt, relies on the wide lens and digital zoom instead
Smaller reviewer base than Nanit or Infant Optics for this age range specifically
Subscription still applies for extended history as a child ages
features: Two-way talk and sound, motion, cry notifications

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
